### 3.2 Detailed Subsystem Notes

#### Fast Decision Engine (src/decision/)

- models.py: FastDecisionRequest, FastDecisionResult, DecisionRoute (8 routes), DecisionOutcome, FallbackReason, ProviderMetrics
- service.py: Main FastDecisionService -- non-blocking admission, qualification thresholds, telemetry
- datasets.py: GOLDEN_ROUTING_QUALIFICATION_SET, ADVERSARIAL_EDGE_TEST_SET
- errors.py: Typed error hierarchy
- providers/base.py: FastDecisionProvider ABC
- providers/von.py: Von 1.1.0 Option-Marker 395M provider (offline, integrity-verified, boundary-enforced)
- providers/von_runtime.py: Runtime constants and artifact manifest
- WARNING: Von model weights NOT downloaded -- provider transitions to DISABLED when checkpoint absent (correct fail-closed behavior)

#### Model Resource Policy (src/model_policy/)

- models.py: ModelArtifact, RuntimeSpec, SkillResourceProfile, SkillExecutionLease, AdmissionDecision, QualificationState, AdmissionResult
- runtime_registry.py: Heterogeneous runtime registry (avoids double-counting shared runtimes)
- residency_manager.py: Ref-counted in-memory residency; eviction safety
- concurrency_manager.py: Qualification-derived ceiling min(target_skills, 1 + (ram_headroom // marginal_ram))
- live_benchmark.py: LiveHardwareBenchmark -- empirical RAM/VRAM delta probing
- qualification.py: ModelHardwareQualifier -- drives live probe, transitions to QUALIFICATION_DERIVED
- storage_policy.py: ModelStoragePolicy -- 30.0 GB global budget, 40.0 GB host floor
- WARNING: Empirical qualification NOT performed -- all concurrency limits are design estimates

#### Storage (src/storage/)

- paths.py: Deterministic path resolution; enforces OneDrive/repo/recovery boundary rules
- database.py: SQLite connection lifecycle (WAL, foreign keys, NORMAL sync)
- migrations.py: Monotonic migration engine with checksum verification and backup preconditions
- health.py: 12-point health evaluation (HEALTHY / DEGRADED / CORRUPT / UNAVAILABLE)
- trust_levels.py: Frozen M0-M4 trust levels with legacy alias resolution
- errors.py: Typed error hierarchy

## 10. Security Invariants

These invariants MUST NEVER be violated by any future implementation prompt:

| # | Invariant | Enforcement |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Intelligence proposes; deterministic authority decides.** LLM/VLM outputs are untrusted proposals | Architectural principle; Trust Core is the authority |
| 2 | **Manager/Skills are NOT security authorities.** They do not authorize capability grants | Trust Core must be the sole gate |
| 3 | **Trust Core remains authoritative.** System-prompt guardrails are never definitive security controls | Architectural invariant |
| 4 | **Least privilege.** Every skill and workflow operates under minimal required permissions; zero ambient authority | Capability-based authorization (designed) |
| 5 | **Fail closed.** Unrecognized actions, malformed inputs, or ambiguous policies default to immediate rejection | Implemented: FDE FALLBACK_TO_MANAGER; storage: ForbiddenDatabaseLocationError |
| 6 | **Scoped capabilities.** Actions require explicit capability grants rather than broad ambient authority | Trust Core capability gating (designed) |
| 7 | **Credentials never enter model context, logs, or memory.** Secrets reside exclusively in Trust Core credential vault | Config loader enforces zero-secret; test_49/50_no_secrets_* tests verify storage |
| 8 | **Network access is policy-controlled.** Declarative NetworkMode enum enforced at runtime | Config model implemented; runtime enforcement designed |
| 9 | **No unrestricted system access.** No skill or model may invoke arbitrary system calls without Trust Core authorization | Architectural design; not yet implemented in runtime |
| 10 | **Security boundaries cannot be overridden by prompts.** FDE is_advisory_only: Literal[True] -- confidence != authorization | Implemented in src/decision/models.py |
| 11 | **External content is untrusted.** Data from networks, uploads, or third-party APIs is tainted | EKM trust levels M0-M4 encode taint |
| 12 | **Memory is not authority.** Retrieved memory items represent historical context, not authorization credentials | Architectural principle |
| 13 | **FDE advisory-only invariant.** FDE can NEVER authorize actions, bypass Trust Core, grant capabilities, or hold credentials | Enforced in FastDecisionResult.is_advisory_only: Literal[True] |
| 14 | **Database boundary invariant.** Active SQLite databases must never reside in OneDrive, Git repo, or C:\AEGIS | Enforced by validate_database_path() |

## 11. Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Value / Rationale | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Canonical repo location | C:\Users\digvi\OneDrive\Desktop\project\aeigs (OneDrive for source backup) | Prompt 003A; AEGIS_FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.md S1 |

| Python version | 3.12.x -- requires-python = ">=3.12, <3.13" | pyproject.toml |
| Venv location | %USERPROFILE%\.aegis\venv (outside OneDrive to prevent sync lock) | AEGIS_DEVELOPMENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPECIFICATION.md S2 |
| Database location | %USERPROFILE%\.aegis\data\aegis.db (outside OneDrive to prevent WAL sync lock) | AEGIS_SQLITE_STORAGE_SUBSYSTEM.md S3 |
| SQLite as sole relational engine | Zero external DB server dependencies; embedded, zero-config, WAL mode | AEGIS_DATABASE_SCHEMA_ARCHITECTURE.md S1 |
| No embedded database in OneDrive | WAL I/O incompatible with OneDrive sync -- programmatically enforced | paths.py::validate_database_path() |
| Dual-layer architecture | Intelligence layer (Manager + Skills) + Deterministic authority layer (Trust Core) | AEGIS_TECHNICAL_FOUNDATION_SPECIFICATION.md S1 |
| Fast Decision Engine is advisory-only | FDE classifies intent; it never authorizes. Confidence != authorization | AEGIS_FAST_DECISION_ENGINE.md S2 |
| Von 1.1.0 pinned to exact commits | Source commit + HF model revision pinned; SHA-256 verification on every checkpoint file | AEGIS_FAST_DECISION_ENGINE.md S4 |
| Model storage outside OneDrive/repo | Models at %USERPROFILE%\.aegis\models\...; OneDrive sync damages model I/O | AEGIS_FAST_DECISION_ENGINE.md S4.3 |
| Concurrent skills target: 2-3 | Not 2-3 resident models -- skills share a single resident model | AEGIS_MODEL_RESOURCE_POLICY.md S1 |
| Qualification-derived concurrency | min(target_skills, 1 + (ram_headroom // marginal_ram)) -- empirical, not hardcoded | AEGIS_MODEL_RESOURCE_POLICY.md S4 |
| System RAM reserve: 1.5 GB | Prevents OS paging and UI freeze under model inference load | AEGIS_MODEL_RESOURCE_POLICY.md S1 + ProvisioningPolicyConfig |
| System VRAM reserve: 512 MB | Preserves OS compositor and display driver stability | Same as above |
| Global model storage budget: 30.0 GB | Hard ceiling on total model artifact disk consumption | src/model_policy/storage_policy.py |
| Host storage floor: 40.0 GB | Minimum free space required before any model download | Same as above |
| Memory trust levels M0-M4 | Formal trust graduation: M0=raw observation -> M4=user-confirmed | AEGIS_DATABASE_SCHEMA_ARCHITECTURE.md S4 |
| Five data classes | USER_CONTENT, OPERATIONAL_STATE, DERIVED_REBUILDABLE, SECRET_EXCLUDED, TRANSIENT_EXCLUDED | AEGIS_DATA_CLASSIFICATION_MATRIX.md |
| Authoritative data recoverable without embeddings | Derived indexes (FTS5, vectors) are never the sole store of any fact | AEGIS_DATABASE_SCHEMA_ARCHITECTURE.md S2 |
| Autonomy tiers frozen at 0-3 | Operational autonomy decoupled from action-risk classification | AEGIS_FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.md S2 |
| Channel-affine routing | WhatsApp->WhatsApp; Desktop->Desktop; cross-channel requires explicit user policy | AEGIS_FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.md S2 |
| No C/C++/Rust toolchains | Absent from host PATH; restrict to pre-compiled binary wheels | AEGIS_FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.md S5 |
| No Docker/WSL2 | Not available on host; AEGIS is native Windows | AEGIS_FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.md S5 |

### 9.2 Root Cause Audit

The original manifest `schemas/model-manifests/von-1.1-option-marker-395m.json` contained three classes of errors introduced at project inception:

1. **Non-existent HF revision**: `4b2d56a297e59b8a07f0f6ea312389d020d18ceb` → HTTP 404 on Hugging Face. This revision was never a real commit on `wfzyx/von`. All 44 HF commits were audited; none matches this hash.

2. **Non-existent required artifact**: `special_tokens_map.json` was listed as `required: true` but does not exist in `wfzyx/von` at any of the 44 audited commits. Confirmed offline-compatible: `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("wfzyx/von", local_files_only=True)` operates correctly without it.

3. **Stale/incorrect SHA-256 digests**: All five SHA-256 hashes in the original manifest were incorrect against the actual artifacts in the repository.

### 9.3 Reconciled Revision

**Selected HF commit**: `308feac9c53d4080df31b7d81362bffbd086de2d`  
**Commit message**: `feat(model): release converged Option-Marker Universal weights`  
**HF push timestamp**: 2026-09-21T20:17Z  
**Paired GitHub source commit**: `bed7e7337791c5124a557eb59ad918cb6747b276` (2026-09-20T13:38Z)  
**Selection rationale**: Earliest HF commit containing all 5 artifacts at sizes exactly matching `von_runtime.py` and `AEGIS_MODEL_RESOURCE_POLICY.md`. Artifact sizes verified stable across 7 commits (`308feac9c5` through `272b292a05`).

**Incompatibility boundary**:
- `3896038655`: `model.safetensors` size changes (~1.579 GB) — incompatible dimensions
- `5df8185a4f`: architecture bumped to `1.2.0` (`independent_options` field) — spec incompatibility

### 9.4 Reconciled Artifact Table

| Artifact | Size (bytes) | SHA-256 (from LFS pointer) |
|---|---|---|
| `config.json` | 6,349 | `968db6072229e54691be4d535487a5c8d8132cc4893b6a3fdfa1e605457a7ec3` |
| `tokenizer.json` | 3,583,485 | `3703d011b3ee259e00b59b60772f8fd54998d79e8fa5a1388d507eff28f8f09e` |
| `tokenizer_config.json` | 599 | `57170b72a72c60407eec1f7894000c567309a8e41c5d0504b946c624cb069984` |
| `model.safetensors` | 1,583,355,740 | `349c9b1bf3d5e3217a78c8039606e07069ffae4383640998f99a96bdb6b90c8d` |
| `option_marker.pt` | 1,581,316,050 | `52202f176080d1efe38ca62c45264894fc7e444d332f4af6bac86f4e3146e0f2` |
| **Total** | **3,168,262,223** | — |

**Hash source**: Git LFS pointer `sha256` fields extracted from raw LFS pointer blobs at commit `308feac9c5`. These are SHA-256 digests of actual file content, not pointer metadata.  
**Verification status**: Hashes are internally consistent (manifest ↔ runtime descriptor). Full on-disk recalculation is mandatory **after download**, before `VonFastDecisionProvider.initialize()` is permitted.

### 9.5 RAM Gate Analysis — Why Safe Stop is Correct

| Metric | Bytes | Human-readable |
|---|---|---|
| Available host RAM (live) | 2,441,334,784 | 2.27 GB |
| System RAM reserve floor | 1,610,612,736 | 1.50 GB (non-negotiable) |
| Usable headroom above reserve | 830,722,048 | ~788 MB |
| Estimated resident model RAM | ~3,000,000,000+ | ~3.0 GB+ |
| Shortfall | ~2,200,000,000 | ~2.2 GB |

The 1.5 GB system RAM reserve is a hard floor enforced by `SkillConcurrencyManager` (configurable, but **must not be lowered** per Prompt 017 constraints). Loading the Von model graph under current host memory pressure would consume all available RAM and severely violate the reserve. Outcome B (Safe Stop) is the correct, well-defined result.

**Gate activation path**: When host RAM headroom falls below `resident_ram + reserve`, `SkillConcurrencyManager.acquire_skill_lease()` returns `None` → `VonFastDecisionProvider.evaluate()` returns `FallbackReason.ADMISSION_BUSY`. No crash, no data loss, no RAM violation. Fully tested by `test_15_dynamic_memory_gate_blocks_heavy_model_under_3gb_ram`.
